About the lab

The hidden heart lab is a collaboration between the research groups of Francisco Sahli Costabal, at the Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile, and Simone Pezzuto, at the University of Trento. Our mission is to unveil the cardiac structure and function from affordable and non-invasive data.
